metadata.title: New Wave Portrait with Geometric Borders

retrievalProfile.description: A slanted central portrait framed by bold red borders with white zigzag edges and small geometric diamond accents.

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical composition featuring a central, slightly tilted rectangular portrait of a man in a suit, set against a neutral grey background. This central frame is flanked by two large red panels with white serrated (zigzag) inner edges. Small, two-toned yellow and orange diamond shapes act as decorative accents in the corners.
coreVisualRelationships: Slanted central frame against a static background
High-contrast red borders framing a neutral grey core
Zigzag edges creating rhythmic vertical movement
Script display text paired with clean sans-serif subtitle
coreInvariants: White zigzag or serrated inner border edges

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure in a medium-close-up, occupying the middle 60% of the frame, tilted approximately 5 degrees clockwise.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the dark suit provide a heavy central anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the script text at the top, move down the subject's face to the clasped hands, then out to the red borders.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the grey background around the head and the large red side panels.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Vibrant red in the side panels.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Neutral cool grey in the central portrait background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow and orange in the diamond shapes; white for the zigzag edges.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation red vs. low saturation grey and black suit.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Fluid, rhythmic script with varying stroke weights.
letterConstructionRules: Connected lowercase letters with long, sweeping ascenders and descenders
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital P with a large, open loop
Lowercase y with a deep, curved tail

composition.relationshipToImage: placed in the upper negative space of the portrait

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Fluid, expressive script paired with a rigid, geometric sans-serif for contrast.

preserve: Script style for the main name

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the fluid, hand-drawn feel of the primary text.
Provides the clean, geometric contrast needed for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a dark suit against a grey background, tilted 5 degrees, framed by red side panels with white zigzag inner edges and small yellow/orange diamonds in the corners.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large black script name at the top center, with a smaller all-caps bold sans-serif title centered immediately below it.

verificationChecks: Are the red borders serrated with white zigzags?
Is the main text a fluid script?

adjustableVariables: Angle of the central frame tilt
Width of the red side panels
Color of the suit and background
mustRedesign: Do not use the specific name or title from the original
Do not replicate the exact facial features of the subject

avoid: Blurry or soft edges on graphics

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the zigzag edges are sharp and consistent
Verify the script text is legible despite its fluid style
Check that the diamond accents are placed symmetrically in the corners
Confirm the tilt of the central image is clearly visible
recipe.reuseFormula: Slanted Portrait + Zigzag Borders + Script/Sans-Serif Pairing
